[SWS_DM_00162] Point in time for positive response for ClearDTC
⌈
The
Diagnostic Server instance shall send a positive response for a ClearDiagnos-
ticInformation service after all memory is cleared in the server. This is regardless how
the Diagnostic Server instance memory is organized (splitted, volatile, non-
volatile).
⌋
